snippet.title: Big Buck Hunter: Ultimate Trophy - Official Announce Trailer
snippet.description:
Features:

Massive Content: 3x more than previous Big Buck Hunter console games.

Expanded Adventures: 9 animal adventures, 27 treks, and 135 hunting sites.

Exciting Bonus Games: Includes 27 mini-games like Pappy’s Moonshine Factory.

Trophy Animals & Critters: Hunt Grizzly Bears, Mountain Lions, and over 48 small critters like Rabbits and Coyotes.

Enhanced Gameplay: New Crossbow weapon and dynamic multiplayer modes (turn-based & simultaneous).

Reimagined Trophy Room: Customizable displays with evolving frames.

Stunning Graphics: Gorgeous global locations and smooth on-rail camera mechanics.
